user_query: I'm a music enthusiast and I want to explore the greatest artists of all time. Can you provide me with the greatest of all time artists chart information? Additionally, suggest some popular songs from Soundcloud that are similar to the style of these artists.

TaskList.description: Fetch the chart information for the greatest artists of all time.
Retrieve popular songs from Soundcloud that are similar to the style of the greatest artists obtained in step 1.
